quest.title: Afterword
quest.description: The nightmare crisis has finally been resolved and you have received a new invitation letter from Mizuki. Finally time for Paimon to enjoy the all-inclusive spa day she's been so looking forward to...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x275, Primogem x60, Mora x22000, Guide to Transience x5, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x5

dialogues.speaker: Hyakujitsuhaku Shion
dialogues.text: Scuse me, hello! Please come register over here!

dialogues.speaker: Shiba Murasaki
dialogues.text: What's going on? Why are there so many guests? Had I known, I'd have definitely turned some of them back...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, looks like business is booming with Emura Ichigensai out of the picture! And it's good to see that Murasaki and Shion are well on the road to recovery.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: #Morning, {NICKNAME}, Paimon. Want to make an appointment?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yes please! For today, if possible!

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Then, I'd better get you another VIP pass. You're our most important customers, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hee-hee, awesome! In that case, Very Important Paimon would like to start with the fine dining this time.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Oh my... Imagine if you'd taken my advice and sold your shares the other day. It could have cost you dearly now that business is booming again. I hope you're not too upset with me, old friend?

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Why would I be upset? It's not as if I ever took your suggestion seriously.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Ah, I've missed that way with words. So affectionate...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Would it kill you to not sneak up on people every darn time...

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Morning, little ones. Did you enjoy the scenery last night?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What? ...You were spying on us?

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Hardly. That tree was directly beneath the Grand Narukami Shrine. What was I supposed to do, move the entire shrine to give you some privacy?

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Is there a reason you're here, Lady Guuji?

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Heh... Mostly because I felt like a walk. But I do have a message from the Tenryou Commission to pass on, as it happens.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: The gentleman who your fellow yumekui-baku fished out of the water last night is no longer in a critical condition. Although, his mind seems to have regressed to that of a young child.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: It could have been worse, I suppose... Lady Guuji, I owe you my thanks. Without your help, things might've gone a lot less smoothly yesterday.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wasn't me...

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Come on, Miko. You've always been worse than me at keeping secrets.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: I admit that I feel inferior around you, and have an urge to prove myself. How could I not? But maybe these feelings are what have driven me to take this business as far as I have.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: My sense of inferiority keeps my ego in check, and my desire to prove myself gives me the strength to persevere. I'm able to accept these parts of me for what they are — there's no need for you to tiptoe around them.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: #*sigh* You could have told me sooner... The poor {NICKNAME} here has been doing all my running around for me.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: #True. But then again, without {NICKNAME}'s help, you'd have been placed in a difficult position.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Emura Ichigensai had amassed a huge following. For the Guuji of the Grand Narukami Shrine to publicly go against him would have been a dangerous move.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: An angry mob of zealots could have done some serious damage to the shrine's reputation... Much safer for the Guuji not to get personally involved. It was the right decision.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: While that's all true, my main concern was that I didn't want to upset an old friend. Otherwise, I could have taken a much more direct approach.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Miko...

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: I always seem to forget that you're more cunning and less adorable than you look... Seems like my worries about upsetting you were unfounded.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: ...It's not that I don't get upset. Everyone has their fair share of troubles... But every sorrow has its cure.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Here's your new VIP Pass. Please take good care of it.

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Could we go over your past experiences when you have a moment? There's a lot of gaps in your medical history I need to fill in.

dialogues.speaker: Hyakujitsuhaku Shion
dialogues.text: So sorry, I'm still registering the last customer...

dialogues.speaker: Shiba Murasaki
dialogues.text: We've gotta turn some of them back...

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Hello, little one. It's been a while since you last came to seek your fortune at the Shrine.
